title: Full remediation acceptance
rawUserRequest: Continue the approved serial remediation plan with WI-15 full remediation acceptance. Run the complete functional, security, usability, efficiency, documentation, governance, quality, and release-preflight evidence review for WI-01 through WI-14; produce an evidence-backed issue overview and known-gap baseline, then complete the full PR/merge/close lifecycle before WI-16 Japanese capability assessment.

rawRequestSource.reference: user authorization: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation continuation

declaredIntent.summary: Establish a complete evidence-backed acceptance baseline and issue overview before the mandatory Japanese assessment.

outOfScope: Implementing new runtime, installer, security sandbox, signing, SBOM, or provider capabilities
Publishing a new version or creating a release tag
Performing the WI-16 Japanese capability assessment
Deleting, rewriting, or cleaning historical plan/archive evidence reserved for WI-19
Changing capability status without fresh implementation evidence

sources.reason: WI-15 scope, acceptance boundary, and predecessor order.
Current capability status is evidence-bound and must not be inferred from this acceptance run.
Required governance and project verification command inventory.
Predecessor WI-14 closure and residual risk evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item aggregates many independent checks; missing or stale evidence must remain visible and must not become release readiness.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial execution of the approved remediation plan; WI-14 is closed.

preReviewWarnings: Do not convert a passing local suite into production, adopter, Japanese, or release readiness; preserve every unknown and external evidence gap.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: All required WI-01 through WI-14 governance and project verification commands are executed or explicitly recorded as not run with reasons.
A complete issue overview distinguishes passed evidence, warnings, blockers, known gaps, external evidence gaps, and residual risks.
The acceptance report does not claim WI-16 Japanese capability, WI-17 Trust Layer documentation completion, WI-18 publication, or enterprise compliance.
The acceptance report and execution plan are aligned and provide the verified baseline for WI-16.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Evidence over self-declaration: every acceptance conclusion cites a command or immutable archived evidence.
Do not silently downgrade not_run, unknown, stale, or contradictory evidence to passed.

intent.problem: The remediation now spans fourteen closed Work Items with different evidence boundaries; without one full acceptance pass, later Japanese assessment and release work could confuse local checks, external evidence, capability truth, and unresolved risks.
constraints: Run verification without changing production, provider, release, or capability claims.
Use existing commands and archived Work Item evidence as sources of truth.
Keep Japanese assessment, Trust Layer document upgrade, publication, and plan cleanup in their later Work Items.
intent.rationale: A bounded acceptance baseline makes the next mandatory Japanese gate evidence-driven and prevents unresolved issues from disappearing between Work Items.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized the complete serial remediation plan, including verification, issue documentation, PRs, closure, and later Japanese/release gates.

rollbackNote: Revert the acceptance report and related generated status/evidence changes; do not alter predecessor archives.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: all required governance and project checks for WI-01 through WI-14
issue overview preserves unknown, stale, external, and capability boundaries
acceptance baseline does not imply Japanese capability or release readiness
scenarioCoverage.reason: Report and plan explicitly keep later gates open.
